result.message: The draft passed review, but the offer looks like a poor fit.
issues: The offer may not fit this company: Nothing in the facts suggests Wise runs warehouses, owns forklift fleets, or has a product need related to warehouse maintenance. For a Head of Product, this offer is a major mismatch to the company’s business and the recipient’s likely priorities.

facts.claim: Wise serves three customer groups through three products: personal customers, small and medium-sized businesses, and banks/enterprises.
facts.excerpt: We serve each of these customer groups through our three products: the Wise Account for personal customers, Wise Business for small and medium-sized businesses and Wise Platform for banks and other enterprises.

facts.claim: Wise says that over 15.6 million customers used it for cross-border transactions in FY2025.
facts.excerpt: During FY2025 over 15.6 million customers used Wise for cross-border transactions and a growing number used other Wise products.

facts.claim: Wise reduced prices and kept building infrastructure for moving and managing money around the world in FY2025.
facts.excerpt: We continued investing in our customers by reducing our prices and building the infrastructure they need to move and manage money around the world, while also broadening our product offering.

facts.claim: Wise’s core products are Wise Account, Wise Business, and Wise Platform, and they are used via its network and APIs.
facts.excerpt: Our three core core products, Wise Account; Wise Business; and Wise Platform, bring these solutions to people, small businesses and other corporations who want to use our network through our APIs.

facts.claim: Wise says its products are cheaper than banks, with transparent fees and instant payments 55% of the time.
facts.excerpt: our payments are instant 55% of the time, we are radically cheaper than banks, our fees are transparent, and our products are a delight to use.

facts.claim: Wise says its platform supports holding and moving 40+ currencies and spending money abroad.
facts.excerpt: With Wise Account and Wise Business, people and businesses can hold 40+ currencies, move money between countries and spend money abroad.

facts.claim: Wise says many customers join through recommendations, and it describes itself as building an evangelical customer base.
facts.excerpt: we are building an evangelical customer base - we served nearly 19 million customers in FY26, with many joining based on a recommendation.

research.website_note: The results identify wise.com as Wise’s official site and investor/newsroom pages for Wise plc.

dropped.claim: Wise reported nearly 19 million customers in FY2026 and over $243 billion in cross-border transactions.
dropped.excerpt: In the financial year 2026, Wise supported nearly 19 million people and businesses, processing over $243 billion in cross-border transactions and saving customers more than $3.3 billion.

strategy.observation: Wise’s core products are digital money-moving services delivered through Wise Account, Wise Business, and Wise Platform via network and APIs.
strategy.offer_link: Forklift maintenance contracts are tied to warehouse operations; Wise’s stated product surface is software and payments infrastructure, so there is no clear reason a Head of Product at Wise would care about warehouse equipment maintenance.
hypotheses: Wise may have internal facilities or logistics spend not mentioned in the facts, but that is only an assumption.
The recipient may care about vendor reliability or operational uptime more broadly, though nothing suggests forklift or warehouse equipment is part of their remit.
strategy.angle: Wise’s core product motion is digital money movement through APIs, not warehouse equipment upkeep.
strategy.fit_reason: Nothing in the facts suggests Wise runs warehouses, owns forklift fleets, or has a product need related to warehouse maintenance. For a Head of Product, this offer is a major mismatch to the company’s business and the recipient’s likely priorities.

draft.subject: Wrong person for forklift maintenance
draft.body:
Wise’s core products are digital money movement through Wise Account, Wise Business, and Wise Platform via APIs. That makes me think forklift maintenance is probably outside your remit.

I help warehouses cut downtime with maintenance contracts that keep forklifts covered and on schedule.

If I’m off base, is there someone on ops or facilities who owns maintenance for physical sites?
